Name: Not Unpacking
Criteria: Take a stairwell down within one in-game hour of arriving on a floor (once per Crawler, ever).
Reward: Platinum box (canon-faithful to A-044; floor caps apply: if the floor's box ceiling is lower, the GM gives the ceiling tier and logs it) + Title: Not Unpacking. Never a Legendary box; never counts against the Legendary cap of 2 (core §4.5).
Notes: Canon ref A-044 (CANON-LEDGER, VERIFIED). Not attainable on Floor 1: stairwells open about 32 h in (M-276) and early descent is stasis (M-277, decision 026). Snark: "Sixty minutes. The welcome mat is still warm. We will be telling the sponsors you were efficient." Rarity tag Legendary is the achievement's rarity, not a box tier.

Name: Down Is a Direction
Criteria: Find a stairwell down to the next floor (once per Crawler, ever).
Notes: Canon ref A-139 (CANON-LEDGER, VERIFIED; canon gives no prize). On Floor 1 the real stairwell is behind the Z10 stage (M-275); Z7 Big Green EXIT is bait. Snark: "Congratulations! You have located the floor's least decorative feature. It goes down. So do you, eventually."

Name: Left Before the Cake

Notes: Canon ref A-151 (CANON-LEDGER, WIKI-ONLY). Early descent means stasis until the collapse (M-277); on Floor 1 attainable only in the stasis form (decision 026). Snark: "Leaving the party at nine-fifteen? Bold. Please enjoy the waiting room while everyone else has fun without you."
